# It is now Monday morning. Forecasters have updated the forecast for
# Saturday (5 days from now). In the previous forecast (7 days out), the
# probability was [varied between respondents]%. The new forecast shows a
# [varied between respondents]% chance of severe weather - including
# tornadoes, damaging winds, or large hail - within 25 miles of where you
# live on Saturday. If you received this forecast, how concerned would you
# feel about the possibility of severe weather at your location on Saturday
# (5 days from now)?
#
# WxDash, the IPPRA Extreme Weather and Society Project. Rebuilds this
# chart from the released wave files and nothing else.
# Severe Weather (WX), WX25.

library(tidyverse)
library(srvyr)

# Read as character: a question asked in one wave is empty in the
# others, and a column empty for its first thousand rows is guessed
# logical, which turns every real value after it into NA.
wx25 <- read_csv("WX25_data_wtd.csv",
                 col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))

d <- bind_rows(
  wx25 |>
    transmute(
      PERSON_WEIGHT = as.numeric(PERSON_WEIGHT),
      resp = exf_exp_d5_concern
    )
) |>
  filter(!is.na(resp), !is.na(PERSON_WEIGHT))

est <- d |>
  as_survey_design(ids = 1, weights = PERSON_WEIGHT) |>
  group_by(resp) |>
  summarise(p = survey_prop(proportion = TRUE, vartype = "ci"),
            .groups = "drop")

est <- est |>
  mutate(
    p = 100 * p, p_low = 100 * p_low, p_upp = 100 * p_upp,
    resp = factor(
      resp,
      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      labels = c("Not at all concerned", "Slightly concerned",
                 "Somewhat concerned", "Very concerned", "Extremely concerned")
    )
  )

ggplot(est, aes(x = p, y = fct_rev(resp))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = p_low, xmax = p_upp),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = str_wrap(paste(
      "It is now Monday morning. Forecasters have updated the",
      "forecast for Saturday (5 days from now). In the previous",
      "forecast (7 days out), the probability was [varied between",
      "respondents]%. The new forecast shows a [varied between",
      "respondents]% chance of severe weather - including",
      "tornadoes, damaging winds, or large hail - within 25 miles",
      "of where you live on Saturday. If you received this",
      "forecast, how concerned would you feel about the",
      "possibility of severe weather at your location on Saturday",
      "(5 days from now)?"
    ), 70),
    x = "Share of respondents (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

library(srvyr)

# Read as character: a question asked in one wave is empty in the
# others, and a column empty for its first thousand rows is guessed
# logical, which turns every real value after it into NA.
wx25 <- read_csv("WX25_data_wtd.csv",
                 col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))

d <- bind_rows(
  wx25 |>
    transmute(
      PERSON_WEIGHT = as.numeric(PERSON_WEIGHT),
      TENURE_GROUP = case_when(
        rent == "1" ~ "Live with family",
        rent == "2" ~ "Rent",
        rent == "3" ~ "Own"
      ),
      resp = exf_exp_d5_concern
    )
) |>
  filter(!is.na(resp), !is.na(TENURE_GROUP), !is.na(PERSON_WEIGHT))

est <- d |>
  as_survey_design(ids = 1, weights = PERSON_WEIGHT) |>
  group_by(TENURE_GROUP, resp) |>
  summarise(p = survey_prop(proportion = TRUE, vartype = "ci"),
            .groups = "drop")

est <- est |>
  mutate(
    p = 100 * p, p_low = 100 * p_low, p_upp = 100 * p_upp,
    resp = factor(
      resp,
      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      labels = c("Not at all concerned", "Slightly concerned",
                 "Somewhat concerned", "Very concerned", "Extremely concerned")
    ),
    TENURE_GROUP = factor(
      TENURE_GROUP,
      levels = c("Live with family", "Rent", "Own")
    )
  )

ggplot(est, aes(x = p, y = fct_rev(resp), fill = TENURE_GROUP)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge2(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = p_low, xmax = p_upp),
                position = position_dodge2(reverse = TRUE),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = str_wrap(paste(
      "It is now Monday morning. Forecasters have updated the",
      "forecast for Saturday (5 days from now). In the previous",
      "forecast (7 days out), the probability was [varied between",
      "respondents]%. The new forecast shows a [varied between",
      "respondents]% chance of severe weather - including",
      "tornadoes, damaging winds, or large hail - within 25 miles",
      "of where you live on Saturday. If you received this",
      "forecast, how concerned would you feel about the",
      "possibility of severe weather at your location on Saturday",
      "(5 days from now)?"
    ), 70),
    x = "Share of respondents (%)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Housing tenure"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
